fields.options: How the customer portal behaves. Whether each portal page exists at all is controlled by Webstore Settings → Features — kept in one place so the two cannot disagree.

fields.label: Portal Landing Page
fields.description: Where /portal sends the customer after login. If the page you pick is switched off in Webstore Settings → Features, they land on the Dashboard instead — a stale setting can never cause a 404.

fields.label: Welcome Note
fields.description: A short line at the top of the portal dashboard. Blank = nothing shown.

fields.label: Support Note
fields.description: Shown on the support and claims pages — e.g. a phone number for urgent cold-chain issues.

fields.label: Months Of Spend History
fields.description: How far back the spend chart and totals on the dashboard reach. 1–36 months.

fields.label: Recent Orders Shown
fields.description: Rows in the “Recent orders” list on the dashboard. 1–50.

fields.label: Top Items Shown
fields.description: Rows in the “Most ordered” list on the dashboard. 1–25.

fields.label: Default Statement Range (Days)
fields.description: The period the statement page opens on, before the customer changes the dates. 1–730.

fields.label: Require A PO Reference To Accept
fields.description: Customers must type their purchase order number before they can accept a quotation.

fields.label: Allow PDF Download
fields.description: Off hides the Download PDF button and refuses the request, so the URL cannot be used directly either.

fields.label: Claim Window (Days)
fields.description: How long after an invoice a claim may still be filed. Invoices older than this drop off the customer's list and are refused if submitted anyway. 1–365.

fields.label: Require A Document
fields.description: Customers must pick one of their own invoices, orders or delivery notes when filing a claim. Only their own documents are ever offered, and the server re-checks.

fields.label: Allow Photo Attachments
fields.description: Lets customers attach photos to a claim — usually the fastest way to settle a quality dispute.

fields.label: Max Attachment Size (MB)
fields.description: Rejects anything larger. Phone photos are typically 2–5 MB.

fields.label: Claim Types
fields.description: The list customers choose from when filing a claim. Empty = the shipped five (Damaged goods, Short delivery, Quality below grade, Billing error, Other). Changing this list does not rename types on existing claims.

fields.label: Allow Name & Phone Edits
fields.description: Lets customers change their own name and phone number from the portal.

fields.label: Allow Adding Addresses
fields.description: Lets customers add delivery addresses. Off means only your team creates them.
